correctness.rationale: In each equality code the two words in each unique-2-position fiber must be complementary off their anchor: any third word anchored at a different position forces that binary opposition. Choose first rows e_ij; the three distinct-anchor words can fail separation precisely when delta_ij xor delta_ik xor delta_jk=0 for delta_ij=e_ij xor e_ji. Every triangle must have odd parity. Fiber swaps s_i normalize all deltas to 1, giving antisymmetric binary tournament incidence, and conversely every tournament gives trifference. All 2^binom(n,2) tournaments identify codes only in global converse pairs, hence exactly 2^(binom(n,2)-1) labeled maxima and at most 2n words. Coordinatewise binary flips toggle columns and upon renormalization toggle exactly crossing edges, yielding cut switching; permutation relabels vertices. Boundary n=2 works without triangle equations. Independently re-enumerated all complementary-pair choices for n=2,3,4 and obtained 1,4,32 labeled maxima, with no use of saved logs; finite checks are not the general proof.
